verdict.rationale: Zulip has a first-party integrations directory listing over 130 native, prebuilt integrations, including incoming webhooks, and its bot framework supports running existing Zulip bots. The evidence does not show a marketplace where a team-admin installs apps in-product with a click; the directory appears to be a catalog, and the setup flow isn't documented here. Missing for 10: evidence of an in-app marketplace or one-click install flow, admin-facing install and permission steps, and independent or hands-on corroboration of installing from the directory.
